# One session of a guest, as the Linux kernel emits it on the NETLINK_AUDIT
# multicast socket and as auditd would write it to /var/log/audit/audit.log.
#
# The story: an intruder fails a password on sshd, gets in on the second try as
# "analyst", runs "sudo /usr/bin/cat /etc/shadow", reloads the firewall, trips
# an SELinux denial on nginx reading the same file, adds an audit rule and
# finally turns the audit subsystem off. Between them the records cover every
# scenario DESIGN.md asks an integration test to produce: a process execution,
# a file access, a login, a sudo command, an nft/netfilter change, a failed
# authentication, an SELinux denial and an audit configuration change.
#
# Records of one logical event share an audit(<secs>.<msecs>:<serial>) event
# id and are separated from the next event by a blank line; a line starting
# with '#' is a comment and is not a record. The blocks are in the order the
# kernel emitted them.
#
# AUDIT_EOE (type=EOE) closes the syscall-driven events, because that is what
# the kernel emits at the end of audit_log_exit(). The user-space records
# (USER_AUTH, LOGIN, USER_CMD, CONFIG_CHANGE, ...) get no EOE from the kernel
# and are closed by SauronAgent's correlation timeout instead, which is why
# both paths are exercised here. auditd strips EOE when it writes audit.log;
# an agent reading the multicast socket sees it.

# 1. Failed password for analyst from a remote address. authentication.failure.
type=USER_AUTH msg=audit(1789752301.123:8412): pid=1421 uid=0 auid=4294967295 ses=4294967295 subj=system_u:system_r:sshd_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 msg='op=PAM:authentication grantors=? acct="analyst" exe="/usr/sbin/sshd" hostname=198.51.100.23 addr=198.51.100.23 terminal=ssh res=failed'

# 2. The second attempt succeeds. authentication.login.
type=USER_AUTH msg=audit(1789752305.451:8414): pid=1421 uid=0 auid=4294967295 ses=4294967295 subj=system_u:system_r:sshd_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 msg='op=PAM:authentication grantors=pam_unix acct="analyst" exe="/usr/sbin/sshd" hostname=198.51.100.23 addr=198.51.100.23 terminal=ssh res=success'

# 3. PAM hands the session its credentials. authentication.login.
type=CRED_ACQ msg=audit(1789752305.455:8415): pid=1421 uid=0 auid=4294967295 ses=4294967295 subj=system_u:system_r:sshd_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 msg='op=PAM:setcred grantors=pam_env,pam_unix acct="analyst" exe="/usr/sbin/sshd" hostname=198.51.100.23 addr=198.51.100.23 terminal=ssh res=success'

# 4. The audit login uid is set: every later event by this session carries
#    auid=1000 however many times the user changes identity. authentication.login.
type=LOGIN msg=audit(1789752305.459:8416): pid=1421 uid=0 subj=system_u:system_r:sshd_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 old-auid=4294967295 auid=1000 tty=(none) old-ses=4294967295 ses=42 res=1

# 5. The PAM session opens. authentication.login.
type=USER_START msg=audit(1789752305.462:8417): pid=1421 uid=0 auid=1000 ses=42 subj=system_u:system_r:sshd_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 msg='op=PAM:session_open grantors=pam_selinux,pam_loginuid,pam_unix acct="analyst" exe="/usr/sbin/sshd" hostname=198.51.100.23 addr=198.51.100.23 terminal=ssh res=success'

# 6. sshd records the login itself. authentication.login.
type=USER_LOGIN msg=audit(1789752305.466:8418): pid=1421 uid=0 auid=1000 ses=42 subj=system_u:system_r:sshd_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 msg='op=login id=1000 exe="/usr/sbin/sshd" hostname=198.51.100.23 addr=198.51.100.23 terminal=/dev/pts/0 res=success'

# 7. sudo authorises a command. The cmd= value is hex encoded because it
#    contains a space: "/usr/bin/cat /etc/shadow". user.command.
type=USER_CMD msg=audit(1789752340.201:8420): pid=4820 uid=1000 auid=1000 ses=42 subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 msg='cwd="/home/analyst" cmd=2F7573722F62696E2F636174202F6574632F736861646F77 terminal=pts/0 res=success'

# 8. The command executes, now as root but still with auid=1000. process.exec.
type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421): arch=c000003e syscall=59 success=yes exit=0 a0=55f0c3a2b2c0 a1=55f0c3a2b340 a2=55f0c3a2b3a0 a3=8 items=2 ppid=4820 pid=4821 auid=1000 uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 suid=0 fsuid=0 egid=0 sgid=0 fsgid=0 tty=pts0 ses=42 comm="cat" exe="/usr/bin/cat" subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 key="exec-watch"
type=EXECVE msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421): argc=2 a0="/usr/bin/cat" a1="/etc/shadow"
type=CWD msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421): cwd="/home/analyst"
type=PATH msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421): item=0 name="/usr/bin/cat" inode=1837 dev=fd:00 mode=0100755 ouid=0 ogid=0 rdev=00:00 obj=system_u:object_r:bin_t:s0 nametype=NORMAL cap_fp=0 cap_fi=0 cap_fe=0 cap_fver=0 cap_frootid=0
type=PATH msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421): item=1 name="/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" inode=2571 dev=fd:00 mode=0100755 ouid=0 ogid=0 rdev=00:00 obj=system_u:object_r:ld_so_t:s0 nametype=NORMAL cap_fp=0 cap_fi=0 cap_fe=0 cap_fver=0 cap_frootid=0
type=PROCTITLE msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421): proctitle=2F7573722F62696E2F636174002F6574632F736861646F77
type=EOE msg=audit(1789752340.225:8421):

# 9. Root opens /etc/shadow for reading: openat(AT_FDCWD, ..., O_RDONLY).
#    file.access.
type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1789752340.240:8424): arch=c000003e syscall=257 success=yes exit=3 a0=ffffff9c a1=7ffd4a1b2e10 a2=0 a3=0 items=1 ppid=4820 pid=4821 auid=1000 uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 suid=0 fsuid=0 egid=0 sgid=0 fsgid=0 tty=pts0 ses=42 comm="cat" exe="/usr/bin/cat" subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 key="shadow-watch"
type=CWD msg=audit(1789752340.240:8424): cwd="/home/analyst"
type=PATH msg=audit(1789752340.240:8424): item=0 name="/etc/shadow" inode=1311 dev=fd:00 mode=0100640 ouid=0 ogid=42 rdev=00:00 obj=system_u:object_r:shadow_t:s0 nametype=NORMAL cap_fp=0 cap_fi=0 cap_fe=0 cap_fver=0 cap_frootid=0
type=PROCTITLE msg=audit(1789752340.240:8424): proctitle=2F7573722F62696E2F636174002F6574632F736861646F77
type=EOE msg=audit(1789752340.240:8424):

# 10. nft loads a ruleset: the kernel reports the netfilter configuration
#     change next to the sendmsg(2) that carried it. firewall.configuration.
type=NETFILTER_CFG msg=audit(1789752352.118:8429): table=filter:2 family=2 entries=1 op=nft_register_rule pid=4841 subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 comm="nft"
type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1789752352.118:8429): arch=c000003e syscall=46 success=yes exit=124 a0=3 a1=7ffc1a2b3c40 a2=0 a3=0 items=0 ppid=4840 pid=4841 auid=1000 uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 suid=0 fsuid=0 egid=0 sgid=0 fsgid=0 tty=pts0 ses=42 comm="nft" exe="/usr/sbin/nft" subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 key="nftables-watch"
type=PROCTITLE msg=audit(1789752352.118:8429): proctitle=6E6674002D66002F6574632F6E667461626C65732E636F6E66
type=EOE msg=audit(1789752352.118:8429):

# 11. SELinux refuses nginx the same file. The denial is the event; the
#     syscall it happened in is only its context. selinux.denial.
type=AVC msg=audit(1789752361.744:8433): avc:  denied  { read } for  pid=4850 comm="nginx" name="shadow" dev="vda1" ino=1311 scontext=system_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0 tcontext=system_u:object_r:shadow_t:s0 tclass=file permissive=0
type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1789752361.744:8433): arch=c000003e syscall=257 success=no exit=-13 a0=ffffff9c a1=7f2b9c0d1e20 a2=0 a3=0 items=1 ppid=1 pid=4850 auid=4294967295 uid=33 gid=33 euid=33 suid=33 fsuid=33 egid=33 sgid=33 fsgid=33 tty=(none) ses=4294967295 comm="nginx" exe="/usr/sbin/nginx" subj=system_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0 key="shadow-watch"
type=CWD msg=audit(1789752361.744:8433): cwd="/"
type=PATH msg=audit(1789752361.744:8433): item=0 name="/etc/shadow" inode=1311 dev=fd:00 mode=0100640 ouid=0 ogid=42 rdev=00:00 obj=system_u:object_r:shadow_t:s0 nametype=NORMAL cap_fp=0 cap_fi=0 cap_fe=0 cap_fver=0 cap_frootid=0
type=PROCTITLE msg=audit(1789752361.744:8433): proctitle=6E67696E783A20776F726B65722070726F63657373
type=EOE msg=audit(1789752361.744:8433):

# 12. A new audit rule is installed. Never an ordinary event: changing what is
#     audited is what an intruder does before doing anything else.
#     audit.configuration.
type=CONFIG_CHANGE msg=audit(1789752372.909:8436): auid=1000 ses=42 subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 op=add_rule key="shadow-watch" list=4 res=1

# 13. Auditing is switched off altogether. audit.configuration, and the last
#     thing this guest will ever report if the agent is not watching for it.
type=CONFIG_CHANGE msg=audit(1789752380.517:8438): op=set audit_enabled=0 old=1 auid=1000 ses=42 subj=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0 res=1
